newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt to part-privatise Alex Flour Mills says TV.
newsitem.headline: Egypt to part-privatise Alex Flour Mills says TV.

text.p: The Egyptian state plans to offer investors at least 10 percent of its stake in Alexandria Flour Mills at a minimum price of 75 pounds ($22.1) per share, state television reported on Tuesday.
It did not say when the offering would be but said it would happen sometime before the end of 1997. The cabinet had approved the sale, it added.

Flour mills are among the state's most successful privatisations, although the government refuses to give up its majority control over what it sees as a strategic sector. The milling shares are very popular on the bourse.
